name: Game starts with every score 0 and round 0
rule_text: When the game starts, every player's score is 0 and round is 0.

name: Round start increments round from a given value (trick outcomes random, only round asserted)
rule_text: When a round starts, round increases by 1, and every player's tricks_won is set to 0, bonus to 0 and hand to empty, while revealed is set to empty.

name: Fresh deck each round: round 1 reveals exactly 3 cards (which cards is random)
rule_text: When a round starts, deck is reset to the 18 cards [1..12, 0, 0, 20, 30, 31, 40].

name: Deal gives 3 cards, so the round plays through and 3 cards are revealed (cards random)
rule_text: When cards are dealt, each player receives exactly 3 random cards from deck into their private hand, and those cards are removed from deck.

name: Reveal leaves exactly 3 public cards with 3 players (cards random)
rule_text: When cards are revealed, 3 further random cards move from deck to the public revealed list, are out of play this round, and leave 3 hidden cards in deck with 4 players or 6 with 3 players.

name: Reveal leaves exactly 3 public cards with 4 players (cards random)
rule_text: When cards are revealed, 3 further random cards move from deck to the public revealed list, are out of play this round, and leave 3 hidden cards in deck with 4 players or 6 with 3 players.

name: Bids are stored as answered and only 0 to 3 are offered
rule_text: When bidding, all players answer at the same time with exactly 0, 1, 2 or 3, and the answer is stored as bid.

name: Bids are public after the poll
rule_text: When all bids are in, every player's bid is shown to everyone.

name: Playing cards over a round completes it (cards random, round asserted)
rule_text: When a trick is played, every player at the same time chooses one card from their own hand, and that card is removed from hand and stored as played.

name: All played cards shown; round completes (outcome random)
rule_text: When all cards of a trick are chosen, every played card is shown to everyone together.

name: Mermaid capture bonus cannot exceed the score lead; dominant seat still wins (deal random)
rule_text: When the played cards include both the Mermaid (20) and the Skull King (40), the Mermaid's player wins the trick even if a Pirate (30 or 31) was played, and gains bonus +10.

name: Highest power wins tricks; round completes (outcome random)
rule_text: When the played cards do not include both the Mermaid and the Skull King, the player with the highest played power wins the trick (for example 31 beats 30, and 1 beats an Escape at 0).

name: Trick wins are counted each round (outcome random, round asserted)
rule_text: When a player wins a trick, their tricks_won increases by 1.

name: Three tricks per round then next round (two rounds played)
rule_text: When the round is played, exactly 3 tricks are played, so each player plays all 3 cards in hand.

name: Max gain per round is 40, so a 100-point lead in the last round decides the winner
rule_text: When a player's tricks_won equals their bid after the third trick (including bid 0 with 0 tricks), their score increases by 30 + bonus (for example bid 1, won 1, bonus 10 gives +40).

name: Max loss per round is 30, so a seat 100 ahead stays ahead (deal random)
rule_text: When a player's tricks_won differs from their bid after the third trick, their score decreases by 10 × |bid − tricks_won| and the bonus is lost (for example bid 3, won 1 gives −20).

name: Game does not end before round 10
rule_text: When round equals 10 after scoring, the game ends; otherwise a new round starts.

name: Game ends after round 10's scoring
rule_text: When round equals 10 after scoring, the game ends; otherwise a new round starts.

name: Highest final score wins (lead too large for one random round)
rule_text: When the game ends, the player with the highest score wins, and players tied at the highest score share the top place.
